telemedicine_app.title: HealthTech Telemedicine & Prescription Platform
telemedicine_app.description: Build an end-to-end HIPAA-compliant telemedicine platform with WebRTC video consultations, automated prescription generation, and Stripe healthcare billing in 6 sprints.

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Factor Auth (MFA) with SMS/TOTP
tasks.user_story: As a patient, I want to authenticate via 2FA so that my sensitive health records remain protected.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given user enters valid credentials, When OTP is sent to mobile, Then user enters correct OTP and gains access within 60s.

tasks.title: Patient Health History Profile & Consent Forms
tasks.user_story: As a patient, I want to fill in my medical history and sign digital consent forms so the doctor is pre-briefed.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given new user profile, When user uploads prior records, Then encryption at rest (AES-256) is applied and timestamped audit log is stored.

tasks.title: WebRTC Video/Audio Consultation Integration
tasks.user_story: As a doctor, I want crystal clear peer-to-peer video streaming with screen sharing so I can consult remotely.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given both doctor and patient are in room, When session connects, Then latency is < 200ms and stream is end-to-end encrypted.
tasks.blocker_reason: Waiting on TURN/STUN server security clearance from DevOps team.

tasks.title: Call Recording & Secure AWS S3 Archive
tasks.user_story: As a clinic admin, I want patient-consented calls securely stored for 90 days for compliance audits.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given consent flag is true, When call completes, Then video is encoded and uploaded to private S3 bucket with KMS encryption.

tasks.title: Digital Prescription Builder with Drug Interaction Warning
tasks.user_story: As a doctor, I want automated drug conflict warnings when prescribing medication so patient safety is guaranteed.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given doctor selects Medication A and B, When known contraindication exists, Then modal warning pops up with severity rating.

tasks.title: Automated Pharmacy Fax & API Dispatch
tasks.user_story: As a pharmacist, I want to receive signed prescription PDFs directly via webhook so fulfillments begin immediately.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given prescription is signed, When doctor clicks send, Then pharmacy partner API responds with HTTP 200 within 3 seconds.

risks.description: TURN/STUN server latency may degrade video quality on low-bandwidth 4G mobile connections.
risks.mitigation_strategy: Implement adaptive bitrate streaming (WebRTC VP8/VP9) and provide automated audio-only fallback mode.

risks.description: HIPAA compliance audit finding unencrypted metadata in analytics logs.
risks.mitigation_strategy: Sanitize all telemetry payload pipelines to strip PII and health identifiers before ingestion.

risks.description: Fullstack lead (Ananya) is over-allocated with both WebRTC engine and Drug interaction engine.
risks.mitigation_strategy: Reallocate Task-105 frontend components to Rohan Verma and bring in 1 contract specialist.

fintech_kyc.title: Fintech Instant KYC & Loan Disbursal App
fintech_kyc.description: Build an AI-powered instant credit eligibility and Aadhaar/PAN verification app with under-5-minute loan disbursals.

tasks.title: Camera OCR for PAN and Driving License
tasks.user_story: As an applicant, I want my document auto-scanned so I don't type manual details.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given clear photo, When OCR engine runs, Then accuracy is > 98% and returns parsed JSON within 1.5s.

tasks.title: Active Face Liveness Detection (Anti-Spoofing)
tasks.user_story: As a risk officer, I want passive/active liveness check to prevent identity impersonation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given live webcam feed, When user blinks or smiles, Then anti-spoofing score > 0.95 flags as real human.

tasks.title: NPCI e-Mandate / UPI Autopay Integration
tasks.user_story: As a lender, I want recurring auto-debit set up before disbursal to secure repayments.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given verified bank account, When user authorizes UPI autopay, Then mandate ID is registered with payment gateway.
tasks.blocker_reason: Sandbox API keys expired; awaiting Razorpay bank compliance renewal.

risks.description: RBI guidelines update on digital lending aggregators requiring onshore server audits.
risks.mitigation_strategy: Ensure AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1) isolated VPC setup with data residency certificates.
